0040: def pbOrganizedBattleEx(opponent, challengedata)
0041:   # Skip battle if holding Ctrl in Debug mode
0042:   if Input.press?(Input::CTRL) && $DEBUG
0043:     pbMessage(_INTL("SKIPPING BATTLE..."))
0044:     pbMessage(_INTL("AFTER WINNING..."))
0045:     pbMessage(opponent.lose_text || "...")
0046:     $game_temp.last_battle_record = nil
0047:     pbMEStop
0048:     return true
0049:   end
0050:   $player.heal_party
0051:   # Remember original data, to be restored after battle
0052:   challengedata = PokemonChallengeRules.new if !challengedata
0053:   oldlevels = challengedata.adjustLevels($player.party, opponent.party)
0054:   olditems  = $player.party.transform { |p| p.item_id }
0055:   olditems2 = opponent.party.transform { |p| p.item_id }
0056:   # Create the battle scene (the visual side of it)
0057:   scene = BattleCreationHelperMethods.create_battle_scene
0058:   # Create the battle class (the mechanics side of it)
0059:   battle = challengedata.createBattle(scene, $player, opponent)
0060:   battle.internalBattle = false
0061:   # Set various other properties in the battle class
0062:   BattleCreationHelperMethods.prepare_battle(battle)
0063:   # Perform the battle itself
0064:   decision = 0
0065:   pbBattleAnimation(pbGetTrainerBattleBGM(opponent)) do
0066:     pbSceneStandby { decision = battle.pbStartBattle }
0067:   end
0068:   Input.update
0069:   # Restore both parties to their original levels
0070:   challengedata.unadjustLevels($player.party, opponent.party, oldlevels)
0071:   # Heal both parties and restore their original items
0072:   $player.party.each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
0073:     pkmn.heal
0074:     pkmn.makeUnmega
0075:     pkmn.makeUnprimal
0076:     pkmn.item = olditems[i]
0077:   end
0078:   opponent.party.each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
0079:     pkmn.heal
0080:     pkmn.makeUnmega
0081:     pkmn.makeUnprimal
0082:     pkmn.item = olditems2[i]
0083:   end
0084:   # Save the record of the battle
0085:   $game_temp.last_battle_record = nil
0086:   if [1, 2, 5].include?(decision)   # if win, loss or draw
0087:     $game_temp.last_battle_record = battle.pbDumpRecord
0088:   end
0089:   case decision
0090:   when 1   # Won
0091:     $stats.trainer_battles_won += 1
0092:   when 2, 3, 5   # Lost, fled, draw
0093:     $stats.trainer_battles_lost += 1
0094:   end
0095:   # Return true if the player won the battle, and false if any other result
0096:   return (decision == 1)
0097: end

0111: def pbPlayBattle(battledata)
0112:   return if !battledata
0113:   scene = BattleCreationHelperMethods.create_battle_scene
0114:   scene.abortable = true
0115:   lastbattle = Marshal.restore(battledata)
0116:   case lastbattle[0]
0117:   when BattleChallenge::BATTLE_TOWER_ID
0118:     battleplayer = RecordedBattle::PlaybackBattle.new(scene, lastbattle)
0119:   when BattleChallenge::BATTLE_PALACE_ID
0120:     battleplayer = RecordedBattle::BattlePalacePlaybackBattle.new(scene, lastbattle)
0121:   when BattleChallenge::BATTLE_ARENA_ID
0122:     battleplayer = RecordedBattle::BattleArenaPlaybackBattle.new(scene, lastbattle)
0123:   end
0124:   bgm = RecordedBattle::PlaybackHelper.pbGetBattleBGM(lastbattle)
0125:   pbBattleAnimation(bgm) do
0126:     pbSceneStandby { battleplayer.pbStartBattle }
0127:   end
0128: end
